map.📚 深度解析：疫苗/驱虫到期提醒系统: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Vaccine/Deworming Due-Date Reminder System
map.为每只宠物建立健康档案（生日、上次疫苗/驱虫日期、间隔周期），自动算出下次到期日: Build a health profile for each pet (birthday, last vaccine/deworming date, interval cycle), and automatically calculate and remind the next due date.
map.幼犬猫按周龄管理首免节奏（如疫苗间隔 21 天、体内驱虫每 30 天），避免漏打: Manage the first-immunization pace of puppies and kittens by week age (e.g. vaccine interval 21 days, internal deworming every 30 days) to avoid missed doses.
map.多宠家庭统一查看到期清单，导出记录便于就诊时出示。: Multi-pet households view the unified due list, and export records for presentation at the clinic.
map.逻辑：下次到期 = 上次日期 + 间隔天数。幼犬首免 2026-01-01、间隔: Logic: next due = last date + interval days. Puppy first immunization 2026-01-01, interval 21 days -> next 2026-01-22; internal deworming every 30 days, last 2026-01-01 -> next 2026-01-31. Week age = (today - birthday) / 7, used to judge the first-immunization window. Data is stored in the local browser and not uploaded.
map.数据存在哪里？安全吗？: Where is the data stored? Is it safe?
map.仅保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，纯前端运行、不上传服务器；换设备或: Stored only in the local browser's localStorage, running purely on the front end and not uploaded to any server; changing devices or clearing cache loses it, so regular export backups are recommended.
map.间隔天数怎么定？: How are the interval days determined?
map.按疫苗/驱虫说明书与兽医建议设定（如核心疫苗首免 2–4 周间隔、体内驱虫幼龄每: Set per the vaccine/deworming instructions and veterinarian's advice (e.g. core vaccine first-immunization interval 2-4 weeks, internal deworming monthly when young / every 3 months when adult). The tool only does date calculation and does not replace the vaccination program; follow your veterinarian's plan.
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据仅保存在本浏览器，不会上传服务器: This tool runs purely on the front end; data is saved only in this browser and will not be uploaded to any server
map.疫苗与驱虫方案参考通用建议，具体请遵医嘱及当地法规: Vaccine and deworming plans reference general advice; follow your veterinarian's instructions and local regulations for specifics
map.更换浏览器或清理缓存后数据会丢失，建议定期导出备份: Data is lost after switching browsers or clearing the cache; regular export backups are recommended
